instruction: Change all text color to blue throughout the presentation by adjusting the Slide Master formatting

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text color to blue via Slide Master view. The custom getter counts total text runs and blue text runs across all slides, using improved blue color detection (b >= 200 and b > max(r, g) * 1.5) that handles multiple blue variations. The getter handles None/theme-default colors and gradient/pattern fills safely. The metric uses the expected parameter to check that all runs are blue (blue_runs == total_runs) when expected.all_blue is True. This is verified by iterating through all slides, shapes, paragraphs, and runs to check the font color RGB values.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks if all text in the presentation is blue by counting total text runs and blue text runs across all slides, shapes, paragraphs, and runs
Metric function correctly uses the expected parameter (expected.get('all_blue', True)) - when expected.type='rule', the framework returns config['rules'] directly, so expected IS {'all_blue': true}
Blue color detection heuristic (b >= 200 and b > max(r, g) * 1.5) is reasonable and handles multiple blue variations
Getter properly handles None/theme-default colors by treating them as non-blue, and safely handles cases where RGB is not accessible (gradients, patterns)
Postconfig includes window activation and Ctrl+S save to ensure file is written to disk before verification
Data flow is correct: getter extracts color counts -> metric compares blue_runs == total_runs -> returns 1.0 (all blue) or 0.0 (not all blue)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider documenting the blue color detection threshold (b >= 200 and b > max(r, g) * 1.5) in code comments for future maintainability
Minor: The treatment of theme-default colors (None) as non-blue is conservative but may fail if the presentation theme itself is blue - consider adding a note about this limitation
